board.note: 30 squares in S-pattern: row 1 (squares 1-10) left-to-right, row 2 (squares 11-20) right-to-left, row 3 (squares 21-30) left-to-right. Positions indexed 0-29 (displayed 1-30).

off_board.note: Pieces that have been borne off the board

movement.condition: destination is empty OR occupied by unprotected opponent
piece is on exit square and throw matches exit requirement

piece.note: 5 pieces per player. Cone pieces are conical, Spool pieces are spool-shaped. Alternating placement on squares 1-10 at start: Cone on 1,3,5,7,9 and Spool on 2,4,6,8,10.

properties.distribution: 4 flat sticks thrown: 0 flat-up=5, 1 flat-up=1, 2 flat-up=2, 3 flat-up=3, 4 flat-up=4

casting_sticks.note: 4 two-sided sticks (one flat, one round). Count flat-side-up sticks. Probabilities: P(0)=1/16, P(1)=4/16, P(2)=6/16, P(3)=4/16, P(4)=1/16. Values 1, 4, and 5 grant an extra turn.

phases.name: throw
phases.note: Server throws 4 casting sticks. Result mapped to movement value: 0 flat-up=5, 1=1, 2=2, 3=3, 4=4.

phases.name: move
phases.ends_when: piece moved OR no legal move exists (turn forfeited)
phases.note: Player moves one piece forward by the throw value. If no legal move exists, the turn is forfeited.

initial_setup.definition: Pieces alternate on squares 1-10: Cone on 1,3,5,7,9 (positions 0,2,4,6,8) and Spool on 2,4,6,8,10 (positions 1,3,5,7,9).

constraints: pieces move forward only along the track
cannot land on a square occupied by own piece
cannot land on a protected opponent piece (opponent with adjacent friendly piece)

swap.trigger: piece lands on a square occupied by an unprotected opponent piece
swap.effect: moving piece and opponent piece swap positions

protection.definition: An opponent piece is protected if it has at least one adjacent friendly piece (immediately before or after it on the track). Protected pieces cannot be swapped.

extra_turn.effect: current player takes another turn after completing this move

house_of_rebirth.definition: Square 15 (position 14). Pieces sent back by the House of Water land here. If occupied, the displaced piece goes to the nearest empty square before it.

house_of_beauty.definition: Square 26 (position 25). All pieces must land here exactly before proceeding to bear off. Cannot be skipped.

house_of_water.effect: piece is sent back to the House of Rebirth (square 15, position 14)

house_of_three_truths.definition: Square 28 (position 27). A piece here can only leave with a throw of exactly 3, bearing off directly.

house_of_re_atoum.definition: Square 29 (position 28). A piece here can only leave with a throw of exactly 2, bearing off directly.

exit_square.definition: Square 30 (position 29). A piece here bears off with a throw of exactly 1.

constraints: piece must be on square 26 or beyond (positions 25-29)
throw value must match the exit requirement for the piece's current square

no_legal_move.trigger: no piece can legally move by the throw value
no_legal_move.effect: turn is forfeited; play passes to opponent (unless extra turn was earned)

end_conditions.condition: all 5 of current player's pieces are in off_board
end_conditions.name: bear_off_all
